scope: Single fixed Chapter2 N500/J60 floor dataset, calibrated Rasch likelihood, same JAGS4.3.2 backend
verdict: The score representation did not complete the predeclared diagnostic workload within the bounded resource allocation; computational acceleration and posterior agreement are not established.
model: Exact fixed-calibration canonical-score likelihood, same physical latent model and priors; known likelihood constant independent of all fitted parameters. Not the source Gaussian sum-score comparator.
diagnostics: Full fixed-draw diagnostic and five-global MCSE comparisons are ineligible and were not run. Adaptation success and checkpoint finiteness are not evidence of convergence. No incomplete chain is pooled with historical chains.
timing: More chain/cleanup time was consumed while fewer draws were retained. This does not demonstrate speedup; it is a bounded feasibility result, not equal-work benchmarking or proof that exact score methods cannot accelerate other implementations. Runtime epochs, starts and RNG streams differ.
independence: Same JAGS backend, source model, calibration and observed dataset. Independent deterministic target checks do not establish independent posterior-engine replication.
coverage: Zero new datasets, zero completed source-count aggregate, no change to original scientific claim verdicts. Chapter2 100-dataset andChapter5 250-dataset recovery/power/sufficiency targets remain pending.
next_evidence: No extension is authorized. Any future algorithm/resource proposal must be justified independently; this capped run provides no automatic production authorization.
source_locators: Schwabe2016 Chapter2 pp17–22 and AppendixA p133
Schwabe2016 Chapter5 pp75–80; distinct model not validated here
